lesson: When planning a change to ARR metrics: identify which TIER you are modifying. (a) Source/Raw change -> base + cross-project upstream review needed. (b) FLA change (currency, line-level dimensions) -> finance_line_analytics. (c) ARR category logic -> get_arr_categories_fn (Snowflake function) and the stg_arr_categories_* stages. (d) Rollup change -> arr_*_categories. (e) Presentation -> the 7 view files only.

Before adding a new cross-project ref, always run dbt deps to refresh the manifest from the upstream project. Without dbt deps, {{ ref('eda_dbt_gtm', '...') }} fails with 'Compilation Error: target model not found'. Cross-project refs share the same Snowflake database but resolve through dbt_project.yml schema configs of the upstream project.

When asked to add a NEW dimension column to ARR: trace the column from source -> stg_em_* -> stg_em_int_strategic_program_flag -> finance_line_analytics -> arr_line_categories -> arr_*_categories. Adding a column at FLA only will NOT surface it in the aggregates (they're built off arr_line_categories which is built off the Snowflake function get_arr_line_base_fn, not directly off FLA). The function consumes columns from its inputs explicitly -- ALWAYS update the function signature if the new column is needed downstream of arr_line_categories.

Adding a new ARR category value (e.g. 'Renewal') requires changes in FOUR places: (1) get_arr_categories_fn CASE statements (sku/subproduct/product tiers, 3 places each), (2) downstream rollup logic in arr_*_categories.sql, (3) any view that filters on arr_category, (4) Sigma dashboards / consumer queries. Estimate 1-2 weeks end-to-end.

For ad-hoc historical / as-of-date analyses, run with dbt build --vars '{"as_was_date": "YYYY-MM-DD"}' --select +arr_line_categories. Each as_was_date is a complete snapshot (delete+insert incremental), so adjacent dates are independent.

Standard ARR change workflow: (1) read the Jira ticket completely including all comments. (2) Identify which DAG tier (FLA / fn / line_categories / aggregates / views). (3) Search analyses/audit/<related-model>/ for existing reconciliation SQL -- those tests encode the validation criteria. (4) Make the change. (5) Run dbt compile to catch ref/macro errors. (6) Run dbt build --select state:modified+ --defer to production manifest for slim CI. (7) Validate using the analyses/audit/ queries before opening PR.

When a Jira ticket says 'add X to ARR': always ask back which tier (SKU/Subproduct/Product) and which currency variant before designing the column add. Three tiers * three variants = nine combinations; stakeholders typically want one but the agent must confirm. Reference: ARR effect decomposition pattern (sku_change_arr + volume + price + mix at 3 tiers).

When asked 'add column X to FLA' planning checklist: (1) Identify BIRTH MODEL (where the column is first computable) — almost always stg_em_int_agree_product_mapped (view) or stg_em_int_agree_base (table) depending on whether it's PH-derived or agreement-derived; (2) Decide derivation point — birth view for all-time flags, get_arr_line_base_fn UDTF for term-dependent flags; (3) Decide tier propagation — line / sku / subproduct / product (use boolor_agg for boolean flags, sum/avg for numerical); (4) Add Jinja fast-path probe in FLA if the column needs to be visible BEFORE the downstream table chain rebuilds; (5) Coalesce to a sane default (false for boolean, 0 for numeric) to avoid tri-valued NULL downstream; (6) Add not_null test (warn-level, conditional on natural id non-null) on every new key column.
evidence: eda-dbt-em PR walk 2026-06-25 (post-IA window: qa #449→#472, prod #459→#465); FLA upstream tree = 43 EM models + 15 cross-project + 2 external dims.

lesson: Overrides require: link to impacted agreements + expected outcome + duration (single-quarter vs longer) + email approval, submitted by Day 4 of close. SSR/termination dates are entered by RevRec (Day 5); ED&A only uploads prepaid-fee adjustments + order-form relationships.
